FAQ

## Answering all your concerns.

- ·Will the content look fake?







Fake content comes from three places: stock voices, stiff AI avatars, zero point of view. Spira runs on the latest frontier modelsfor voice, video, and image, and every persona has its own style baked in. 100 accounts won't sound like one. We won't pretend it's magic though: weak persona in, weak content out.

- ·Has anyone actually grown with this?







We ran 42 accounts ourselvesfor 90 days before opening it up. Top performers crossed 25k+ followers from zero, median landed around 3.8k. Results track with content strategy, not luck.

- ·How much does it cost? How many accounts can I run?







Unlimited accounts. [Pricing](https://spira.ai/pricing) starts at $19/monthand scales with how much you generate, not how many seats you open. Tell us your goal: one flagship, a 10-account niche matrix, a 50-account geo play. We'll architect the setup and build it with you.

- ·Can I plug in my own brand assets?







Yes. Upload your logo, product shots, reference videos, and slogan library. Spira treats them as priority source material. Persona avatars lock to a reference face, so the same character stays consistent across every post. No drift.

- ·Why not just use another AI tool, or hire a social media manager?







Other tools generate. Spira operates. They hand you a 30-second clip. You still pick the topic, edit, post, read the data, adjust. A human hire runs $3–6k/monthand covers 1–3 accounts. Spira Pro is $149/month, runs 10+ accounts, 24/7. It won't replace your strategy, but it replaces 90% of the execution.

- ·What platforms does it run on, and how fast will it learn my niche?







Publishing is live on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X, with Facebook covered for trend intelligence. New platforms roll out continuously. On niche: day one it's already posting because you define it at setup. Real learning kicks in after the first posts. It rebalances by week 2, and by week 3–4you'll feel it get measurably sharper.
